card.name: Overdose wording in poison-help advice
card.fires_on: Parts of the word overdose (Over-d, overdos-age, additional overdose) in advice to call the Poison Help line or in the opioid reversal-agent heading. It also fires weakly on a few unrelated linking words.

modes.label: Overdose word pieces
modes.description: Fires on the d or age piece, or on the word overdose, in the Poison Help line advice or the opioid overdose reversal agent heading.
modes.example: Patient Access to an Opioid Over<<d>>ose Reversal Agent for the Emergency

modes.label: Scattered linking words
modes.description: Fires on a single small word or comma in plain explanatory sentences.
modes.example: Doctors call yellow discoloration<< of>> the eyes jaundice.

card.plain: It lights up on the word overdose in the standard advice to call the Poison Help line and in the opioid reversal heading.
